delta_definition: Panels A/B: actual signed endpoint minus actual signed initial. Panel C: actual signed component at each stored step minus its own actual initial value. Panel D: actual total stress norm without subtraction.
interpolation: none; full contract mesh with midpoint edges and masked missing cells

summary.claim: Preliminary conditional independent matter/radiation response in warm near-z4 LRS Bianchi I; no full EoR or donor/escape Q^a closure or convergence claim.

component_definitions.matter: D_m=Pi_massive; isotropic gas/dust contribute zero anisotropic stress
component_definitions.radiation: D_r=Pi_gamma+Pi_nu+Pi_UV; each evaluated at the actual current state
component_definitions.total: D_total=D_m+D_r, then take norm; component norm sum is diagnostic only

total_definition: norm after signed D_m+D_r; component norms are never added as total
